# hetznerrobot_traffic (Data Source)

Queries the traffic of IP addresses and subnets over an interval, in GB. `day` sums hours within a day, `month` days within a month, `year` months within a year; data exists only once the hour, day or month has passed. Addresses without traffic data are left out of `entries` by Robot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Daily traffic of a server's main IP and its IPv6 subnet in September 2026.
data "hetznerrobot_traffic" "september" {
  type          = "month"
  from          = "2026-09-01"
  to            = "2026-09-30"
  ips           = ["123.123.123.123"]
  subnets       = ["2a01:4f8:111:4221::"]
  single_values = true
}

output "september_total_gb" {
  value = sum(data.hetznerrobot_traffic.september.entries[*].sum)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from` (String) Start of the interval: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH` for `day`, `YYYY-MM-DD` for `month`, `YYYY-MM` for `year`.
- `to` (String) End of the interval, in the same format as `from`.
- `type` (String) Query type: `day`, `month` or `year`.

### Optional

- `ips` (List of String) IP addresses to query. Set `ips`, `subnets` or both.
- `single_values` (Boolean) Group the data by hour (`day`), day (`month`) or month (`year`) instead of one sum per address.
- `subnets` (List of String) Subnet addresses to query (the network address, e.g. `2a01:4f8:111:4221::`).

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Traffic per address — and per interval with `single_values`, sorted by address and interval. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) IP address, or subnet in CIDR notation.
- `in` (Number) Incoming traffic in GB.
- `interval` (String) Hour, day or month of the value (`01`, `02`, …) with `single_values`; null otherwise.
- `out` (Number) Outgoing traffic in GB.
- `sum` (Number) Total traffic in GB.
